**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4473-landing-no-strand`.

**Ruling**: land the today-implementable half, per the triage note. The invariant: **switching into an organization never strands the user** — the app surface bounces to `/home` (with shell chrome) when the resolved app is not accessible, which also covers hand-typed `/_console/apps/<name>` URLs. The resolver's product-decision character stays untouched (it still picks the app from metadata); the guard is at the surface. The clean "filter candidates by per-user access / distinguish no-access from not-published" half stays gated on the backend envelope (objectstack#8013, tracked under #4252) — record the dependency in the PR body; if the bounce turns out to require that envelope too, STOP and report. Red-first: reproduce the chrome-less state (member + inaccessible landing app → `document.querySelectorAll('header').length === 0` today), assert post-fix the user lands on `/home` with chrome present; pin the direct-URL case too.

**Grading**: patch (apps/console and/or `@object-ui/app-shell` by where the bounce lands — measured, `.d.ts`-checked).

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.tsx` + the app-surface component that renders the chrome-less empty state + tests + changeset. Disjoint from in-flight #4472 (organizations/manage), #4463 (views/ObjectView), #4431, #4471. Do NOT touch `WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx` (its full-page navigation is correct) unless measurement proves the bounce cannot live at the surface — report first if so.
